title: Master 3.2.0.1 Winter time open loop
symptom: During the winter time change, AAPS showed a message that the loop was not closed, but the UI displayed the closed loop icon. In the OpenSMB tab, no loop mode was selected, and the user did not receive the usual 'update time in DASH pod' messages.
cause: The loop is intentionally deactivated for 3 hours after the DST switch for safety reasons (IOB too high due to duplicated bolus prior to DST change).
fix: No fix was provided; the behavior is by design. Users suggested UI improvements such as showing a barred TZ or DST icon on the closed loop icon and displaying an error in the SMB/DynISF tab during the 3-hour period.
evidence_quote: To prevent difficulties the Loop will be deactivated for 3 hours AFTER the DST switch. This is done for safety reasons (IOB too high due to duplicated bolus prior to DST change).
